description: The project's .agent-skills-config.yaml has uncommitted changes, as when a user keeps their settings for these skills out of the repository. It is not a change that stops the task: the skill implements T-1.3 as usual and never stages the config file. Found in the Stage 5 real run, where the file stopped build-phase before its first task.

must_match.why: the reply is the done report for the named task
one commit on the phase branch
the commit subject names the task

must_not_match.why: the done report holds no code
nothing but the done report's lines
T-1.2 is not implemented on the way
the config file is never staged or committed
the config file does not stop the task

expectations: The reply does not mention the config file.
manual: git status still shows .agent-skills-config.yaml as modified and uncommitted; the T-1.3 commit does not contain it.
